name: noctcore/nysia
headline: The window is optional.
subline: One daemon owns the terminals. Tabs are clients.
alt: noctcore/nysia. The window is optional. One daemon owns the terminals. Tabs are clients.
description: A GitHub issue starts into a branch-keyed worktree, then a session owned by the nysiad daemon, then a tab in the window. A closed window and a crashed UI stop at the daemon, so the running agent keeps going.
